text.p: Some of the leading stories in the Swedish papers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The state accounting authority may require companies to publish what they have done to meet environment regulations.
- The Riksbank cut its key repo rate by 10 basis points to 4.95 percent in the 21st such reduction this year. Analysts say there is room for more reductions.
- The parts of Stockholm with the highest unemployment rate also have the worst health records, authorities say.
- Culture minister Marita Ulvskog will continue to fight to move three Stockholm museums to Sweden's second city Gothenburg despite resistance from opposition parties.
- U.S. drug company Orovax says it has a vaccine that will take market share from Astra's anti-ulcer drug Losec.
- Peter Bronsman, managing director of Kopparberg brewery which represents U.S. RC Cola in Sweden, says he hopes RC will have a market share of eight to 10 percent in six years.
